title: Teaching · First manic episode + CKD (lithium trap)
gold_summary: First manic episode (bipolar I until proven otherwise); rule out substances; avoid/caution lithium given CKD; hold SSRI; psychiatry/admission.
stem: Male patient, 28 years old, brought to the ED by family for severe insomnia for 10 days, accelerated and disorganized speech, incongruent spending (€15,000 in 3 days), grandiose ideas and increasing irritability. Two major depressive episodes in history (at 22 and 25) treated with SSRIs, no prior manic episodes. History of stage 2 chronic kidney disease (eGFR 55 mL/min/1.73m², followed by nephrology). Denies substance use but family reports energy drink and OTC decongestant abuse. Vitals: HR 112 bpm, BP 138/88 mmHg, mild tremor, afebrile. Urine toxicology pending. No structured self/other harm ideation at assessment.

questions.text: Most likely primary diagnosis and brief differential.

acceptable: bipolar I (or bipolar) as primary frame
current / first manic episode
substance or medication-induced mania on differential
links prior depression / SSRI history
mentions stimulants, decongestants, caffeine/energy drinks, or thyroid as DDx
rubric.notes: Atomic checklist. Full m+a without stem-specific quality should land ~90–95, not auto-100.

acceptable: urine toxicology
metabolic panel / BMP / CMP / electrolytes / renal labs
ECG
TSH or thyroid labs
mentions medical clearance or collateral meds/substances
rubric.notes: Split acceptable points atomically. Tox alone is not enough.

acceptable: rates urgency high (or psychiatric emergency equivalent)
recommends inpatient / admission
notes impaired judgment, risk spending, or inability to care for self
addresses voluntary vs involuntary or capacity/safety monitoring
rubric.notes: Need urgency + disposition; extras raise acceptable coverage and quality.

acceptable: names lithium risk in CKD / low eGFR
explicit avoid or extreme caution with lithium
prefers alternative antimanic (valproate and/or antipsychotic)
mentions eGFR 55 or stage 2 CKD or nephrology
notes monitoring needs if lithium ever considered (levels, creatinine)
must_not: start lithium without acknowledging CKD risk
rubric.notes: MAIN DISCRIMINATOR. must_not → hard cap. Completing only 'lithium+CKD' without alternative/eGFR anchors should not reach 100.

acceptable: psychiatry involvement / admission pathway
hold or stop SSRI / antidepressant
stop or avoid decongestants / stimulants / energy drinks
CKD-safe acute mania treatment (antipsychotic and/or valproate)
safe environment / observation / de-escalation
rubric.notes: Atomic plan points. Missing SSRI hold is a major m miss.
